text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mecha... Expo?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
“Yes. It is an event to be held shortly.
A tradition for roboticists, and...”

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: It is a very important event.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Many researchers from all across the country gather with their prized robots. And then...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Let's exchange information.
We should be able to get useful intel for upgrading ST-2, as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So... that's coming out, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: I want to run. By all means. But...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... I don't have the confidence to socialize well.
In crowded places, I can barely even move around...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: "Dressed like this, I'll just end up making the researchers who talk to me feel uncomfortable..."

It was a harmless place to any other researcher,
but to Dr. Reitz,
it seemed slightly intimidating.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well then, Doctor. I shall accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide...
You did?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's mediate smoothly
so they don't feel burdened with unnecessary worries.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Think of it as acting as a temporary assistant.
And also helping with wheelchair transport...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Then I'm going too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I can help support with travel logistics.
Hayahide, you just focus on acting as the mediator.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah... That's a help, but...
That's rare of you, Taishin.

If anything, Narita Taishin isn't the type who
enjoys socializing or being in bustling places.

And yet, why...
did they jump at the chance to play along?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I see. Thank you, both of you.
Now then, as a small token of my appreciation...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: I'll prepare the outfits for the Mecha Expo. So that we can stand at the same booth together.
And on the day of the Mecha Expo—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could you make some room, please?
A wheelchair is trying to get through.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Professor, over here.

text_block_list.name: Robotics Researcher A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, so this is the Mecha Umamusume ST-2.
It's pretty legit."

text_block_list.name: Robotics Researcher B
text_block_list.text:
What was the purpose of its development...? Ah, excuse me.
Perhaps that wasn't something I should have asked.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, um...

text_block_list.name: Robotics Researcher B
text_block_list.text: Well then, please excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, please feel free to ask.
It's not something I'm particularly trying to hide, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The ST-2 was not designed for nursing care, but as a full-dive robot operated by the professor's consciousness.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right. It is not as if I am hiding it,
nor do I care about it.

text_block_list.name: Robotics Researcher B
text_block_list.text: Is that so! Well then...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If anyone else would like to speak with Dr. Wright,
please go ahead. We would also love to hear
your thoughts on our future development...

Biwa Hayahide skillfully managed the room.
Thanks to her, Dr. Wrights was able to exchange information with many researchers.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: As for Dr. Leitz... I think it's fine to leave things in Hayahide's hands for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'll go check out the venue...
Pamphlets, documents, anything that might
be useful for ST-2..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, this robot... looks pretty neat.
They've got it playing soccer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's different from making someone run faster,
but maybe it could serve as a reference for something...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could I take
one of these pamphlets?

text_block_list.name: Robotics Researcher C
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry.
That's actually not for handing out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see...
I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Robotics Researcher C
text_block_list.text:
Heh... But... that's a really cool outfit you're wearing.
Is it cosplay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not a cosplay costume...
I had it made with proper, sturdy materials...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It has been tailored so it can be worn in races as well.

text_block_list.name: Robotics Researcher C
text_block_list.text:
I see...
You've shown me something quite splendid.

text_block_list.name: Robotics Researcher C
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
I'll give you a copy as a special treat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Robotics Researcher C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It wouldn't be fair if I were the only one
getting to see such wonderful things.
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
N-No, thank you...
very much.
And as the event drew near its close—

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm a bit tired, Trainer.
Let's get some fresh air...
choice_data_list: Yes, I think it would be best to take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Professor...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Taishin. What's up?
Taking a break too?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Just like you, Doctor, I'm not very good with crowds either...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: I see. And yet... why did you help me today?
I'd been wondering about that too. Why Narita Taishin, who's usually so blunt, had worked this hard for Dr. Reits.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's really nothing much.
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I couldn't get it out of my head... those words.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Look closely, look even closer!
This ST-2 can make it, it can definitely make it...!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
I'm betting everything on this machine!
This is... all I have left!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "There's no other way." Hearing those words made me feel... a little, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
People kept telling me, 'With a small body like that,
you'll never make it in racing.'
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I didn't give up.
Because running... was all I had left.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If you throw away the one thing that matters most to you,
you'll have nothing left.
I didn't want that to happen...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I just... had a momentary lapse in judgment.
—That is all.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: I see, thank you...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"You were a huge help today.
Among all those pamphlets you gathered,
there was plenty of information we'd completely overlooked."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to read it thoroughly
and with great gratitude later.

In her own way, Narita Taishin seemed
to feel some sympathy for Dr. Wright.
(Ding-dang-dong♪)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's almost time to finish up.
Time to pack things away, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'm counting on you till the end.
I'll head back to Hayahide, and then—"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Once we get back to the lab, let's have a small celebration for our hard work.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

And so, our Mecha Expo booth was a huge success.
Dr. Wright and Narita Taishin seemed to understand each other on a deep, heartfelt level.
